en.title: Two Italians killed in Kuwait drone strike as Iran denies involvement
en.dek: Iranian-made drones targeted Kuwaiti military installations, killing two Italian technicians working for Rheinmetall, while Tehran denies responsibility.
facts: Two Italian Rheinmetall technicians killed in Kuwait drone strike on 26 November 2026
Iranian-made drones targeted Kuwaiti military installations including an air-defence detection station
Iran's foreign ministry assigned responsibility for the attack to Iran
Iran's FM Abbas Araghchi called the Kuwait incident "suspicious" and a "pre-cooked recipe" for war
Italian FM Antonio Ta confirmed the drones were Iranian-made and targeted the air-defence detection station
Iran denied involvement, according to BBC and CNA
body: On 26 November 2026, a drone strike in Kuwait killed two Italian technicians working for the German company Rheinmetall, according to Italy's foreign ministry and multiple international outlets.

Italian and international media reported the strike involved Iranian-made drones targeting Kuwaiti military installations, including an air-defence detection station where the technicians were working.

Iran's foreign ministry assigned responsibility for the attack to Iran, while Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi described the incident as "suspicious" and suggested it looked like a "pre-cooked recipe" for war, according to Al Jazeera.
The New York Times and Los Angeles Times described the strike as an Iranian drone attack, citing officials, while Iran denied involvement, according to BBC and CNA.

Italian Foreign Minister Antonio Ta stated that several Iranian-made drones targeted Kuwaiti military installations, including the air-defence detection station where the two technicians were working at the time of the strike.
Tagesschau reported that Italy has assigned responsibility for the attack to Iran, while Tehran continues to deny involvement.
en.context: A drone strike in Kuwait on 26 November 2026 killed two Italian technicians from the German company Rheinmetall who were working at a military site. Iranian-made drones targeted Kuwaiti military installations, and responsibility for the attack has been assigned to Iran by Italian officials, while Iran denies involvement.

en.headline: Iran FM calls Kuwait attack suspicious
en.body: Iran's FM Abbas Araghchi says the deadly Kuwait incident is "suspicious" and looks like a "pre-cooked recipe" for war. Around 2:00 p.m. today, several Iranian-made drones targeted Kuwaiti military installations, including an air-defence detection station where two Italian technicians from Rheinmetall were working, according to Italian FM Antonio Ta.

de.headline: Iranischer Außenminister Araghchi bezichtigt Kuwait-Angriff von verdächtiger Natur
de.body: Irans Außenminister Abbas Araghchi bezeichnet den tödlichen Vorfall in Kuwait als "verdächtig" und sieht darin ein "vorbereitetes Rezept" für einen Krieg. Nach Angaben italienischer Außenminister Antonio Ta. griffen gegen 14:00 Uhr heute mehrere iranische Drohnen militärische Einrichtungen Kuwaits an, darunter eine Luftabwehrorganisationsstation, an der zwei italienische Techniker von Rheinmetall arbeiteten.

fr.headline: Le ministre iranien des Affaires étrangères qualifie l'attaque du Koweït de suspecte
fr.body: Le ministre iranien des Affaires étrangères Abbas Araghchi qualifie l'incident mortel au Koweït de "suspect" et évoque un "recette toute faite" en vue de la guerre. Vers 14h00 aujourd'hui, plusieurs drones fabriqués en Iran ont visé des installations militaires koweïtiennes, dont une station de détection anti-aérienne où travaillaient deux techniciens italiens de Rheinmetall, selon le ministre italien des Affaires étrangères Antonio Ta.

it.headline: Il ministro degli Esteri iraniano definisce sospetto l'attacco al Kuwait
it.body: Il ministro degli Esteri iraniano Abbas Araghchi definisce l'incidente mortale in Kuwait "sospetto" e sembra una "ricetta pronta" per la guerra. Intorno alle 14:00 di oggi, diversi droni iraniani hanno preso di mira installazioni militari kuwaitiane, inclusa una stazione di rilevamento della difesa aerea dove due tecnici italiani di Rheinmetall stavano lavorando, secondo il ministro degli Esteri italiano Antonio Ta.

es.headline: El ministro de Asuntos Exteriores iraní califica de sospechoso el ataque a Kuwait
es.body: El ministro de Asuntos Exteriores de Irán, Abbas Araghchi, considera el mortífero incidente de Kuwait "sospechoso" y parece un "receta pre cocinada" para la guerra. A las 14:00 horas de hoy, varios drones fabricados en Irán atacaron instalaciones militares kuwaitíes, incluida una estación de detección de defensa aérea donde trabajaban dos técnicos italianos de Rheinmetall, según el ministro de Asuntos Exteriores italiano, Antonio Ta.

ja.headline: イラン外相、クウェート攻撃を「疑わしい」と非難
ja.body: イランのアッバース・アラグチ外相は、クウェートでの致命的な事件は「疑わしく」、戦争への「事前に用意されたレシピ」のようだと述べた。イタリアのアントニオ・タヤーニ外相によると、本日午後2時ごろ、イラン製ドローン数機が、ラインメタル社のイタリア人技術者2人が勤務していた防空探知施設を含むクウェートの軍事施設を攻撃した。

zh.headline: 伊朗外长称科威特遇袭事件可疑
zh.body: 伊朗外长阿巴斯·阿拉格奇表示，这起造成人员死亡的科威特事件“可疑”，看起来像是为战争准备的“预先炮制的方案”。据意大利外长安东尼奥·塔亚尼称，今天下午约2时，数架伊朗制造的无人机袭击了科威特军事设施，其中包括一个防空探测站，当时有两名来自莱茵金属公司的意大利技术人员正在那里工作。

pt.headline: Ministro dos Negócios Estrangeiros do Irão considera ataque ao Kuwait suspeito
pt.body: O Ministro dos Negócios Estrangeiros do Irão, Abbas Araghchi, afirma que o fatal incidente no Kuwait é "suspeito" e assemelha-se a uma "receita pré-preparada" para a guerra. Por volta das 14h00 de hoje, vários drones de fabrico iraniano visaram instalações militares kuwaitianas, incluindo uma estação de deteção de defesa aérea onde dois técnicos italianos da Rheinmetall estavam a trabalhar, segundo o Ministro dos Negócios Estrangeiros italiano, Antonio Ta.

ko.headline: 이란 외무장관, 쿠웨이트 공격 '의심스럽다'
ko.body: 이란의 압바스 아라그치 외무장관은 이번 쿠웨이트에서 발생한 치명적인 사건이 '의심스럽다'며 전쟁을 위한 '미리 준비된 레시피'처럼 보인다고 말했다. 이탈리아 외무장관 안토니오 타에 따르면, 오늘 오후 2시경 이란산 드론 여러 대가 레인메탈 소속 이탈리아 기술자 두 명이 근무하던 방공 탐지 시설을 포함한 쿠웨이트 군사 시설을 표적으로 삼았다.
